_about: The app preview video's timeline, shared by capture.mjs, music.py and compose.py. One bar of music is 3.5 s (68.57 beats a minute, 4 beats a bar: 105 frames at 30 fps); a scene is 'bars' long (1 if not given), 8 bars in all (28 s). Each scene is filmed 12 frames longer, for the dissolve into the next. mark: a soft highlight over one line of the screen, [from s, to s, y in the app's points (443 x 960), label]. soft: [s, ...] moments the screen changes at once (closing, opening), eased over 1/5 s. chip: [from s, to s, label], a small dark label on the screen. tap: [s, name], a touch where capture found it (frames/<scene>/where.json).
